title: Block Galaxy
tagline: Drag neon blocks, clear cosmic lines, chase today's daily score.
description: Block Galaxy is a neon-glow block puzzle for short cosmic browser sessions. Drag tetromino-style pieces from the tray onto an 8x8 cosmic grid. Fill any full row or column to clear it in a chromatic burst, chain consecutive clears for huge combo multipliers, and chase the daily seeded score that resets every midnight. Every day brings a new piece sequence, so the leaderboard is a fresh race for everyone. Featuring a hand-tuned neon palette of cyan, pink, violet, lime, amber and coral, real-time bloom and chromatic aberration post-processing, slow-rotating star fields, procedural Web Audio space ambient music, satisfying ASMR-style block thunks and pentatonic clear bells, screen-shake on big chains, full-screen safe-area support, and a one-tap PWA install. Designed for adults during short breaks: one round lasts one to three minutes, plays beautifully on portrait mobile, and never wastes your time with forced ads.

controls.en: Drag a piece from the tray onto the 8x8 grid. Drop on a valid spot to place it.
controls.ja: 下のトレイからブロックを8x8グリッドにドラッグ。置ける位置で離して配置。

engineNotes: Next.js 16 + React Three Fiber + drei + postprocessing
